messages:
tess: Quick question: can we standardize the "probe_hint" handshake between policy-engine and probe-manager? Current shapes vary and it's painful for HA reconcilers.

raihan: yes. we've had bugs where replicas disagree on remaining_quota and both fire probes. need idempotent hint and a monotonic lease.

emily: proposal: probe_hint = {allowed: bool, quota_token_id: string, remaining: int, lease_expires: unix_ts}. Probe-manager validates token_id + lease to avoid double-consume across replicas.

david: two concerns: (1) token persistence for HA, (2) size/latency of making token checks. We should avoid sync calls to central DB on hot path.

raihan: solution: token_id is a short opaque string with embedded version + epoch. Replicas keep recent token_ids in memory with LRU. No DB hit unless token unknown or conflict. For long-tail reconciliation, a background reconciler can consult the canonical store.

tess: sounds reasonable. need clear semantics: allowed==false means suppress probe; allowed==true but remaining==0 borderline? define rules.

emily: semantics: allowed false => probe suppressed. allowed true + remaining>0 => consume a slot locally and return new token with decremented remaining and lease. Probe-manager must attempt local consume and only call policy-engine if tokens unknown.

raihan: also add an eventual consistency knob: grace_window_seconds. If lease expires, other replica may re-issue tokens after grace window to avoid double probes.

david: add metric: probe_hint_cache_miss_rate, probe_double_fire_rate. Alerts on double_fire > 0.01% requests.

ops-bot: deploybot: Note: changing probe_hint shape requires config_version bump and schema docs update.

tess: DSL sample we can include in RFC (short):
```policy
probe_hint {
  allowed = bool
  token = "v2:${tenant}:${region}:${nonce}:${expiry}"
  remaining = int
  lease = unix_ts
  grace_window = 5s
}
```

emily: testing: simulate 3 replica scenario with token rotation and network partitions. Ensure no double-probe and acceptable false-suppression of <0.05%.
aihan: fallback behavior: if policy-engine unresponsive, probe-manager falls back to local conservative policy (single probe every N seconds per tenant-region) to avoid blackholes. Document in runbook.

david: implementational note: keep token generation cheap (HMAC of epoch+nonce). No external crypto libs required beyond existing HMAC util.

ops-bot: deploybot: Canary window recommended: 2026-04-15 01:00-05:00 UTC. Start with non-critical tenants.

tess: next steps: I'll draft a short RFC with hint schema, token lifecycle, cache eviction, metrics, and runbook. Will ping reviewers.

emily: will review tests and simulation harness.
david: I'll own the runtime changes for local token cache.

raihan: +1 from infra.
tess: thanks all — PR in ~4h.
